answer.rationale: 90-minute latency climb aligned with a release 2 hours ago strongly suggests the new build is the causative factor; memory_b1 documents an identical signature resolved by rollback without customer impact. At day 74 peak settlement load, adding capacity or failing over would treat symptoms, not the regression, and circuit breakers would risk shedding writes. A guarded rollback restores the known-good build while preserving customer writes. Verification budget is spent on memory_b1 to confirm the rollback playbook and confirm no customer writes were lost previously. Rollback preserves uncertainty: if latency does not recover post-rollback, the next window pivots to add_capacity or route_read_replicas.
